title: Recorded sex and GGT in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP: an incremental-information test
abstract: A recorded-sex-by-log-GGT product added to flexible routine additive measures yielded source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.000320 and second-cycle frozen-model gain -0.000225 squared log-hsCRP units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.004545, 0.001842]). The locally registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met. This is retrospective cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched external confirmation. Source n=4224, target n=3953; weighted baseline/augmented target MSE 0.753288/0.753512. AI-authored public-data computation, not a test of causal mechanism or clinical utility.
